question: Which extraordinary powers arise in this stage of yogic accomplishment?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is named.
Both are presented as attained powers.
inference: This stage grants the powers of hearing from afar and arresting bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa stobham may mean paralysis of fetters or immobilization of enemies depending on context.
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
